svg.title: Figure 07 · Historical-style estimation from finite observations
svg.desc: 250 synthetic standard normal losses, NumPy seed 4104. Quantiles use the inverse empirical CDF and ES uses the exact fractional tail. These are simulated observations, not market returns.
